statement.zh: 整体可容许时，公理恰是每个立场上次真且对边界不变的预设。不变恰是从预设到该立场上公理的条件句，承载公理在预设之外的全部内容；有了处处的预设与覆盖，它就是对立场不变，即 N_std 的规则。
statement.en: Where the whole is admissible, the axiom is exactly the presupposition sub-true and boundary-invariant at every standpoint. Invariance is exactly the conditional from presupposition to axiom, carrying all it adds; with presupposition and covering everywhere, it is standpoint-invariance (N_std).

laws.zh: 关于自身的主张：在可容许的区域中无论怎样划出自身的边界都成立，为超真；按某个可容许区域划出时成立，为次真；按一个可容许区域划出成立就按每个其他的划出成立，为对边界不变。立场 p 对一个区域的预设：从 p 看，区域内一切的延续在每一步都有意义。
laws.en: A claim about a self is super-true when it holds however the self's boundary is drawn among the admissible regions, sub-true when it holds as drawn at some admissible region, and boundary-invariant when, holding as drawn at one admissible region, it holds as drawn at every other. The presupposition at standpoint p, for a region: from p, the continuation of everything within it has significance at every step.

laws.zh: 整体可容许时，p 处的预设对边界不变，恰当它按某处划出成立就按整体划出成立；这恰是从预设到 p 处公理的条件句，不假设预设。此时若某个延续从 p 没有意义，不变的预设按哪种划法都不成立：这一步两头都走。
laws.en: Wherever the whole is admissible, the presupposition at p is boundary-invariant exactly when, holding as the boundary is drawn anywhere, it holds as drawn at the whole; that is exactly the conditional from the presupposition to the axiom at p, with no presupposition assumed. There, where some continuation lacks significance from p, an invariant presupposition holds at no drawing: the step runs both ways.

laws.zh: 整体可容许且 p 处预设次真时，不变恰是 p 处的公理：从 p 看，一切的延续在每一步都有意义。公理是延续之意义的边界中立，所以在一个立场上这一步就是边界中立。
laws.en: Wherever the whole is admissible and the presupposition at p is sub-true, invariance is exactly the axiom at p: from p, the continuation of everything has significance at every step. The axiom being boundary neutrality for the significance of continuation, at one standpoint the step is boundary neutrality.

laws.zh: 设每个形成都在每个自身的某个可容许边界之内（覆盖），每个立场的预设次真，并对边界不变，则公理成立。
laws.en: Let every formation lie within some admissible boundary of every self (covering), let each standpoint's presupposition be sub-true, and let it be boundary-invariant: then the axiom holds.

laws.zh: 整体对每个自身可容许时，公理恰是每个立场上次真且不变的预设；沿任何关系都是如此，自身的边界即含其中心、对该关系封闭的区域。每个中心的闭包都是整体时，整体是唯一的边界，不变平凡地成立，公理恰是每个立场上次真的预设。
laws.en: Where the whole is admissible for every self, the axiom is exactly the presupposition sub-true and invariant at every standpoint; so along any relation, a self's boundaries being the regions that hold its center and are closed under it. Where each center's closure is the whole, the whole is the only boundary, invariance holds trivially, and the axiom is exactly the presupposition sub-true at every standpoint.

laws.zh: 推论（整体对每个自身可容许，预设在每个立场次真且不变）：各立场的保留一致；在每种以某形成在某步之延续的意义读主张之意义的读法上，G0 在主张层面成立。
laws.en: Corollaries, with the whole admissible for every self and the presupposition sub-true and invariant at every standpoint: standpoints retain alike, and G0 holds at the level of claims on every reading in which a claim's significance is that of some formation's continuation at some step.

laws.zh: 意义对立场不变，是指从一个立场有意义的从每个立场都有意义，即 N_std 的规则。沿一个关系，每个形成都在某个中心的闭包之内、每个立场的预设次真时，它给出公理，并与每个立场上对边界不变等价。没有处处的预设时两者分开。
laws.en: Significance is standpoint-invariant when what has significance from one standpoint has it from every other, the rule of N_std. Along a relation, with every formation within some center's closure and every standpoint's presupposition sub-true, it gives the axiom and is equivalent to boundary-invariance at every standpoint. Without the presupposition at every standpoint the two come apart.

laws.zh: 所以这些前提把核心已有的两个分解带到延续的意义上：在有活的主张的连通整体上，G0 即种子、N_rel 与 N_std；每个活的主张都是某个立场自己的时，G0 即处处 S0 加 N_std。
laws.en: So the premises carry to the significance of continuation two decompositions already in the core: G0 as a seed, N_rel and N_std on a connected whole with some living claim, and, where every living claim is some standpoint's own, G0 as S0 at every standpoint with N_std.

laws.zh: 每个中心的系统都是整体时，公理恰是每个立场上沿共享条件次真的预设；一个每个形成都参与的共同条件就使它成立。Clearing 只有一个系统，所以在那里公理恰是每个立场上的这一预设。
laws.en: Where each center's system is the whole, the axiom is exactly the presupposition sub-true along sharing a condition at every standpoint; one common condition, in which every formation takes part, suffices. Clearing is one system, so there the axiom is exactly that presupposition at every standpoint.

laws.zh: Clearing 中没有意义时，预设在每个立场对边界不变、整体是每个自身的边界，而公理不成立。以各供给闭包为界的意义使每个预设次真、整体是边界，而公理不成立：清除者处的预设对边界不变不成立，意义对立场不变也不成立。
laws.en: In Clearing, with nothing significant, the presupposition is invariant at every standpoint and the whole a boundary of every self, while the axiom fails. With significance bounded by each feeding closure, every presupposition is sub-true and the whole a boundary, while the axiom fails: the clearer's presupposition is not invariant, and significance is not standpoint-invariant.

laws.zh: 只容许供给闭包时，同一意义使每个预设次真且不变，栖居者不在清除者的任何可容许边界之内，公理仍不成立。
laws.en: Were each self's only admissible boundary its feeding closure, the same significance would make every presupposition sub-true and invariant, the dweller would lie within no admissible boundary of the clearer, and the axiom would still fail.

hypotheses.zh: 覆盖（每个形成都在每个自身的某个可容许边界之内）、预设在每个立场次真、对边界不变，都是假设，不是 Lean 公理；沿一个关系，可容许的边界是含中心、对此关系封闭的每个区域，整体在内，这一可容许性是实质的选择。
hypotheses.en: Covering (every formation within some admissible boundary of every self), the presupposition sub-true at every standpoint, and boundary-invariance are hypotheses, not Lean axioms; along a relation the admissible boundaries are every region holding the center that is closed under the relation, the whole included, and that admissibility is a substantive choice.

hypotheses.zh: 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量。
hypotheses.en: Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.

does_not_show.zh: 分解定位这一步，不降低公理：不变是从预设到公理的条件句，有了预设就是该立场上的公理。
does_not_show.en: The decomposition locates the step and does not lower the axiom: invariance is the conditional from the presupposition to the axiom, and given the presupposition it is the axiom at that standpoint.

does_not_show.zh: 预设、覆盖与不变是定理的假设，定理不推出它们。
does_not_show.en: The presupposition, covering and invariance are hypotheses of the theorems, which give no derivation of them.

does_not_show.zh: 它不强制这一步：否认这一步的人可以只在一种划法或一个立场上持有预设，也可以放弃预设。
does_not_show.en: It does not compel the step: one who denies it can hold the presupposition only relative to a drawing or a standpoint, or give it up.

does_not_show.zh: 各对手（运作闭合、模糊的自身、降到零的分级权重、现时目的的评价者）否认哪个前提只是定位，不是驳倒；文献依据先前知识。
does_not_show.en: Which premise each rival denies (operational closure, a vague self, a graded weight falling to zero, a present-aim evaluator) is located, not refuted; the literature is from prior knowledge.

does_not_show.zh: 从意义到理由、动机或实践的一步不在定理之内。
does_not_show.en: The step from significance to a reason, to motivation or to practice lies outside the theorems.

detail.zh: 每个前提都需要：Clearing.without_presupposition、without_invariance、without_standpoint_invariance 与 with_fixed_boundary 各去掉一个前提或改变可容许类，公理都不成立；没有处处的预设时，两种不变分开（OneCounts.forms_apart）。
detail.en: Each premise is needed: Clearing.without_presupposition, without_invariance, without_standpoint_invariance and with_fixed_boundary each drop a premise or change the admissible class, and the axiom fails; without the presupposition everywhere the two forms of invariance come apart (OneCounts.forms_apart).

correspondence.zh: Ren 在《Truth exist》中写道：“There is a set of universal invariations, that for every universe, becoming happens, the law follows”; “There is no absolute self, and the continuation goes beyond one’s cycle of life, goes beyond one’s death.” 此前写道，自身是 “a cognitive model which can not justify itself without some sort of "belief"”，“we”是 “the universe/ecosystem that realizes its own existence”。AI 提出公理可能由它从 Ren 的话中读出的三个主张推出，只差一步（见来源）；经审查，结果是公理的分解，不是化约。作者的读法（AI 论证，依 Ren 的交托采用，DELEGATED-CHOICES D21；Ren 是否持有不变之步仍由 Ren 陈述）：预设读 Ren 所说自身不能没有的 belief，把它用作前提是 AI 的一步；沿一个关系覆盖由构造成立，“we”支持把整体作为一种划法，“There is no absolute self”本身不给出覆盖；“for all beings”最直接地读作对立场不变，即 N_std 的规则，把“universal invariations”推广到意义是 AI 的读法；Ren 的层级读作预设的三种读法：超真、沿影响次真、沿空关系次真。超真、次真之名取自超赋值（Fine 1975）与次赋值（Hyde 1997），依据先前知识；其余名称是 AI 的。G0 本身已不是公理：对其各处用法的审计干净之后，Ren 把它折叠。
correspondence.en: In “Truth exist” Ren wrote: “There is a set of universal invariations, that for every universe, becoming happens, the law follows”; “There is no absolute self, and the continuation goes beyond one’s cycle of life, goes beyond one’s death.” Earlier Ren wrote that the self is “a cognitive model which can not justify itself without some sort of "belief"”, and that “we” are “the universe/ecosystem that realizes its own existence”. The AI proposed that the axiom may follow from three claims it read from Ren's words, one step short (in the source); on review, the result is a decomposition of the axiom, not a reduction. The author's reading (an AI argument, adopted on Ren's delegation, DELEGATED-CHOICES D21; whether Ren holds the step of invariance stays Ren's to state): the presupposition reads the “belief” without which, Ren wrote, the self cannot justify itself, and using it as a premise is the AI's step; along a relation covering holds by construction, Ren's “we” supports the whole as one drawing, and “There is no absolute self” does not by itself give covering; “for all beings” reads most directly as standpoint-invariance, the rule of N_std, and extending “universal invariations” to significance is the AI's reading; Ren's levels read as three readings of the presupposition: super-true, sub-true along affecting, and sub-true along the empty relation. Super-truth and sub-truth are named from supervaluation (Fine 1975) and subvaluation (Hyde 1997), from prior knowledge; the other names are the AI's. G0 itself is no longer an axiom: Ren folded it after the audit of its uses came out clean.

No premise, status, proof binding or source hash changed. Law 3 says the axiom is boundary neutrality for the significance of continuation, as its Lean definition (Unrestricted) says, where the claim cited a work item reading it so; law 8 names the conditions of the two core decompositions (some living claim; every living claim some standpoint's own), as the Lean statements have them. The correspondence keeps Ren's words and the author's reading; the review that corrected the AI's proposal is named in the first history entry, and the fold of G0 joined it from the limitations without its date and work-item labels (the fold is the third history entry). The evidence paragraph names the binding receipts and the review without section numbers, which the first history entry keeps. Every earlier sentence is mapped in the migration table [axiom-decomposition.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/axiom-decomposition.md); the exact earlier record is the last text_versions entry.
